gaps.requirement: Implementation produces real artifacts that are traceable in evidence graph
gaps.why_e38_did_not_verify: E38 harness populates self.artifact_trace during execution but E38_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json saved with empty artifacts array. The artifact_trace was not correctly passed to save_evidence(). Evidence store has artifacts but evidence graph does not.
gaps.required_evidence: E38_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json.artifacts populated with all 10+ artifacts including artifact_id, path, sha256, task_id, agent_role
gaps.required_implementation: Fix harness.save_evidence() to include self.artifact_trace in E38_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json. Ensure artifact_trace is populated for all tasks including recovery task.
gaps.verification_method: Re-run E38 and verify E38_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json.artifacts.length >= 10 with correct fields
gaps.exit_criterion: E38_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json.artifacts array non-empty and matches evidence_store/artifacts.json

gaps.requirement: Verifier independently validates implementation (separate agent, separate execution)
gaps.why_e38_did_not_verify: Verifier agent (e38-verifier-001) was registered in AgentFactory but never selected for any task. All verification done by ExecutionEngine._verify_task() inline. No independent OperationalVerifierAgent execution for role tasks.
gaps.required_evidence: E38_ROLE_TRACE.json must include 'verifier' with agent.started events. E38_VERIFICATION_TRACE.json must contain verification records from independent verifier.
gaps.required_implementation: Modify task graph to assign t8_verification to AgentType.VERIFIER. Ensure MissionController executes verifier agent for verification task. Use OperationalVerifierAgent for independent verification.
gaps.verification_method: Re-run E38 and verify verifier role appears in E38_ROLE_TRACE.json and E38_VERIFICATION_TRACE.json non-empty
gaps.exit_criterion: Verifier role executed at least once with independent verification result

gaps.requirement: Replanned execution resumes correctly with updated dependency graph
gaps.why_e38_did_not_verify: Recovery task t6_security_audit_fixed created but task graph dependencies not updated. t7_testing still depends on failed t6_security_audit instead of recovery task. Recovery task execution not verified in checkpoints.
gaps.required_evidence: E38_TASK_GRAPH.json dependencies updated: t7_testing depends on t6_security_audit_fixed. Checkpoint_post_recovery shows recovery task COMPLETED.
gaps.required_implementation: In harness.recover_and_replan(), update task graph dependencies to point to recovery task. Ensure recovery task executes and completes before dependent tasks.
gaps.verification_method: Re-run E38 and verify t7_testing depends on t6_security_audit_fixed in task graph, and recovery task shows COMPLETED in checkpoint
gaps.exit_criterion: Dependency graph correctly references recovery task; recovery task completes; dependent tasks execute after recovery

gaps.requirement: Evidence graph reconstructs why final claims are trusted (claim→requirement→artifact→evidence→verification chain)
gaps.why_e38_did_not_verify: E38_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json saved with empty arrays for artifacts, evidence_records, verifications. The runtime traces (artifact_trace, evidence_trace, verification_trace) were empty at save time.
gaps.required_evidence: E38_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json with non-empty artifacts[], evidence_records[], verifications[] showing full traceability chain
gaps.required_implementation: Populate artifact_trace, evidence_trace, verification_trace during execution. In save_evidence(), include all three in E38_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json. Link each verification to its evidence and artifact.
gaps.verification_method: Re-run E38 and verify E38_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json contains complete chain for at least one task
gaps.exit_criterion: For at least one task: claim → requirement → task → action → artifact → evidence → verification all traceable in E38_EVIDENCE_GRAPH.json

gaps.requirement: Final result is independently verified (producer != verifier)
gaps.why_e38_did_not_verify: Same execution path (ExecutionEngine._verify_task) both produces and verifies. No independent verifier agent execution. Producer and verifier are the same code path.
gaps.required_evidence: E38_VERIFICATION_TRACE.json shows verification by independent agent (verifier role). Producer task (implementation) and verifier task are separate with separate agents.
gaps.required_implementation: Separate verification task execution to OperationalVerifierAgent. Ensure verifier agent runs independently and produces verification result that is recorded separately from producer artifacts.
gaps.verification_method: Re-run E38 and verify verifier agent executed independently, verification recorded in E38_VERIFICATION_TRACE.json with verifier identity
gaps.exit_criterion: Independent verifier agent executes and produces verification distinct from producer artifacts

gaps.requirement: No mock replaces a required production execution path
gaps.why_e38_did_not_verify: All role-specific tasks (explorer, analyst, planner, designer, reviewer) use ContextAgent (test harness class) not OperationalImplementerAgent/OperationalVerifierAgent. ContextAgent is a test double that directly writes artifacts without real agent logic.
gaps.required_evidence: E38_ROLE_TRACE.json shows operational agent types (OperationalImplementerAgent, OperationalVerifierAgent) executing role tasks, not ContextAgent.
gaps.required_implementation: Replace ContextAgent with operational agents for role tasks. Use AgentFactory to create real operational agents for each role. Or verify that ContextAgent IS the operational implementation (but it's not - it's a test harness class).
gaps.verification_method: Re-run E38 and verify agent class names in role_trace are operational agents, not ContextAgent
gaps.exit_criterion: All role tasks executed by operational agent implementations, not test harness mocks

gaps.requirement: E38 artifacts are reproducible from the repository (fresh execution from repo+inputs+command)
gaps.why_e38_did_not_verify: No reproduction mechanism exists. E38 artifacts only exist in temp directory from test run. No script to re-execute from repository state and compare outputs.
gaps.required_evidence: E39_REPRODUCTION_TRACE.json showing fresh execution from repository producing comparable artifacts. Hash comparison between original and reproduced artifacts.
gaps.required_implementation: Create reproduction script that: 1) Checks out E38 commit, 2) Runs E38 test, 3) Captures artifacts, 4) Compares hashes with original E38 artifacts. Document environment and inputs.
gaps.verification_method: Execute reproduction script and verify at least one artifact reproduces exactly (same hash)
gaps.exit_criterion: At least one E38 artifact reproduced from repository with matching hash, or differences documented and explained
